INSERT INTO "public".renovacao_anuncios 
    (user_id, bid_id, nome_produto, email, telefone, tipo, sent, expire, created_at, ultimo_anuncio)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.creator_id) 
    b.creator_id,
    b.id,
    p.name,
    u.email,
    f.telefone_limpo,
    CASE 
        WHEN b.status_id IN (2, 3) THEN 'expirado'
        WHEN b.status_id = 1
             AND b.created <= now()::timestamp - interval '8 days'
          THEN '8dias'
        ELSE 'ativo'
    END AS tipo,
    false AS sent, 
    b.expire,
    b.created,
    b.created AS ultimo_anuncio
FROM an_prod_cbc.bids b
LEFT JOIN an_prod_types.products p ON p.id = b.product_id
LEFT JOIN an_prod_cbc.users u ON u.id = b.creator_id
LEFT JOIN an_prod_cbc.user_profiles up ON up.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN an_prod_cbc.profile_phones pp ON pp.profile_id = up.id
LEFT JOIN an_prod_cbc.phones phones ON phones.id = pp.phone_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN ltrim(regexp_replace(phones.number, '\D', '', 'g'), '0') LIKE '55%' 
                THEN ltrim(regexp_replace(phones.number, '\D', '', 'g'), '0') 
            ELSE '55' || ltrim(regexp_replace(phones.number, '\D', '', 'g'), '0') 
        END AS telefone_limpo
) f
WHERE b.deleted = false 
  AND b.created >= '2022-01-01' 
  AND phones.number IS NOT NULL 
  AND length(f.telefone_limpo) >= 10 
ORDER BY b.creator_id, b.created DESC, phones.id DESC
ON CONFLICT (user_id) 
DO UPDATE SET
    bid_id          = EXCLUDED.bid_id,
    nome_produto    = EXCLUDED.nome_produto,
    telefone        = EXCLUDED.telefone,
    tipo            = EXCLUDED.tipo,
    expire          = EXCLUDED.expire,
    created_at      = EXCLUDED.created_at,
    ultimo_anuncio  = EXCLUDED.created_at,
    sent = CASE 
                WHEN "public".renovacao_anuncios.created_at != EXCLUDED.created_at 
                  OR EXCLUDED.tipo = 'ativo'
                THEN false 
                ELSE "public".renovacao_anuncios.sent 
           END,
    sent_at = CASE 
                WHEN "public".renovacao_anuncios.created_at != EXCLUDED.created_at
                  OR EXCLUDED.tipo = 'ativo'
                THEN NULL 
                ELSE "public".renovacao_anuncios.sent_at 
              END;

SELECT id, user_id, bid_id, nome_produto, email, telefone
FROM "public".renovacao_anuncios
WHERE sent = false
  AND tipo = 'expirado'
  AND (sent_at IS NULL OR sent_at < now() - interval '30 days')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 80;

O banco decide quem entra na fila e normaliza os telefones.

### 2. EXPIRADOS (template_renovacao)
Batch WA check → variantes do 9 → 1 por telefone → envio via Meta HTTP.

### 3. > 8 DIAS (template_renovacoes2)
Mesma trilha, template sem valor.
